items.title: LLM-RAG SYSTEM FOR DISASTER MITIGATION
items.desc: Fine-tuned Whisper for Indonesian disaster-specific ASR — up to 2.5× lower word error rate than the vanilla model. Built the RAG data layer: transcribed YouTube audio into structured text, auto-filtered via ChatGPT & Gemini APIs.

items.title: MINERBAONE GOVERNANCE WEB APP
items.desc: Database architecture for Indonesia's mineral & coal governance (ESDM): analysed thousands of tables across legacy systems, unified them into one MDM source, designed a dynamic warehouse and refactored ORM queries into raw PostgreSQL.

items.title: WEB SENTIMENT ANALYSIS DASHBOARD
items.desc: TF-IDF enhanced with statistical feature engineering + SVM, shipped as an intuitive web dashboard. Findings presented at the 3ICT conference and published in the IEEE proceedings.
